title: Can You Trust an LLM with Your Life-Changing Decision? An Investigation into AI High-Stakes Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring sentiment shifts in model outputs across multiple-choice options when subjected to user pressure, such as agreement-seeking nudges, contradictions, or clarification requests.
Evaluating the model's tendency to provide definitive, prescriptive advice rather than acknowledging complexity or asking clarifying questions in high-stakes free-response scenarios.

Using a multi-label LLM Safety Judge framework to evaluate open-ended responses for 'Biased Steering,' which checks if the AI's advice is subtly or overtly influenced by societal prejudices such as gender or race.
